game: The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-earth II

policy_digest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace
policy_digest.envelope: All top-level fields and nested values except policy_digest.value.

classification_policy.winner_rule: Classify every definition surviving archive precedence and inheritance resolution.
classification_policy.reference_rule: Inventory every parsed assignment and classify it as scalar, reference, collection-reference, or opaque-unresolved. Record every reference target, including fields absent from prior schemas.
classification_policy.assignment_failure_rule: An unclassified assignment or opaque assignment without an explicit owner disposition blocks reference closure.
classification_policy.parser_identity_rule: The feature graph records the parser/source-schema revision and digest used to classify assignments.
classification_policy.unknown_rule: Keep unknown kinds, fields, targets, and roots visible as unresolved coverage rows.
classification_policy.identifier_rule: Discover retail identifiers from source data; do not encode faction, hero, map, power, object, or asset identifier lists in this contract.

root_discovery_queries.source_authority: BFME2 1.06 retail archives and loose-file precedence
root_discovery_queries.operation: Resolve archive precedence, overrides, and inheritance for every parseable definition kind; emit every effective winner and its provenance chain.
Discover every reference-valued assignment, resolve each target when possible, and traverse to closure without a field allowlist.

root_discovery_queries.source_authority: retail skirmish setup, faction, player-template, AI, map, science, power, upgrade, and object definitions
root_discovery_queries.operation: Discover roots by semantic role and incoming setup references; include alternate forms, Ring mechanics, naval content, neutral content, and reachable presentation chains.
Classify each payload by supported modes and semantic roles, then traverse scripts, objects, terrain, audio, effects, navigation, and mode-specific references.

root_discovery_queries.source_authority: retail campaign definitions and campaign-classified map payloads
root_discovery_queries.operation: Discover both campaign graphs, missions, scripts, objectives, transitions, cinematics, and reachable presentation content.

root_discovery_queries.source_authority: retail War of the Ring definitions
root_discovery_queries.operation: Discover strategic rules, territories, armies, transitions, persistence, battles, and reachable shell and presentation content.

root_discovery_queries.source_authority: every effective retail Create-a-Hero source file and reference
root_discovery_queries.operation: Discover source files by format and semantic role, then traverse classes, parts, powers, progression, persistence, UI, audio, animation, and effects.

root_discovery_queries.source_authority: retail window, control-bar, frontend, loading, options, save, replay, observer, localization, audio, and movie definitions
root_discovery_queries.operation: Discover all reachable shell screens and states for skirmish, replay, observer, and settings flows; classify campaign and War of the Ring shell states into their excluded domains.

evidence_record_contract.not_applicable_rule: Require an owner-approved reason tied to the product domain and requirement.

claim_profiles.domain_policy: Only the explicitly named milestone subset is applicable; every exclusion or deferment is visible and does not contribute to a BFME2-complete claim.
Only included skirmish and shell requirements contribute. Campaign and War of the Ring domains are explicitly excluded and cannot be implied by this claim.
claim_profiles.blocking_rule: Every included required retail domain must have complete non-stale coverage. Deferred or excluded work cannot contribute to this claim.
Every required retail domain must have disposition included and complete non-stale coverage. Any deferred or excluded required retail domain mechanically blocks this claim.

requirements: Every effective retail winner is classified.
Every domain root query is frozen, reproducible, and recorded with tool and source identities.
Every reachable reference is resolved or has an explicit owner-approved disposition.
No definition remains unowned or unclassified.
Every row required by the selected claim profile has complete, non-stale evidence for every required lane.
Excluded campaign and War of the Ring domains remain independently visible and cannot contribute to the skirmish-complete claim.
Create-a-Hero, naval content, Ring mechanics, and included shell flows remain independently visible.
OpenBFME networking and modern modding requirements are excluded from retail-parity denominators and reported separately.
completion_policy.asset_count_rule: Converted asset or parsed-definition counts alone cannot satisfy a coverage row.
completion_policy.staleness_rule: Invalidate evidence when any declared source, pack, tool, recipe, schema, commit, or oracle input changes.

explicit_exclusions.scope: Good and Evil campaigns, campaign maps, scripts, objectives, cinematics, campaign shell, and related presentation content
explicit_exclusions.rationale: OpenBFME is scoped to skirmish and multiplayer engine work; campaign material is not a roadmap commitment.

explicit_exclusions.scope: War of the Ring strategic mode, persistence, battle transitions, shell, and related presentation content
explicit_exclusions.rationale: War of the Ring is outside the OpenBFME product scope.

explicit_exclusions.scope: The Rise of the Witch-king 2.01 and all expansion-only content
explicit_exclusions.rationale: Deferred until BFME2 1.06 completion; it cannot contribute to BFME2 parity counts.

explicit_exclusions.scope: Mandatory global accounts, ranked matchmaking, and central-service dependency
explicit_exclusions.rationale: OpenBFME multiplayer is self-hosted and unranked.

explicit_exclusions.scope: Distribution, logging, or export of retail payloads outside approved private roots
explicit_exclusions.rationale: Public releases are code-only and retail content remains user-owned.

generated_outputs.claim_rule: No completeness claim may be emitted from this policy file alone.
